verse.text: ‘He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death’ or mourning or crying or pain, for the old order of things has passed away.”

reflection.scripture: ‘He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death’ or mourning or crying or pain, for the old order of things has passed away.”
reflection.observation: This verse paints a breathtaking picture of the new heaven and new earth — a future where God personally removes every trace of sorrow. Not just death ends, but the sources of our deepest pain: mourning, crying, pain itself. The phrase 'the old order of things has passed away' reminds us that this broken world — with its grief, disease, and loss — is temporary. God isn't just patching things up; He's making all things new.
reflection.application: When you're in a season of grief or heaviness, it's easy to believe this brokenness is permanent. But today's verse is an anchor for your soul — pain has an expiration date. Let this truth shape how you respond to hardship today: grieve honestly, but don't grieve without hope. Hold this promise in your heart like a treasure, and when sorrow surfaces, remind yourself: This is not the final chapter.
reflection.prayer: Lord, thank You that You don't just promise relief — You promise to personally wipe away every tear. When my heart feels heavy today, remind me that this pain is temporary, but Your love is eternal. Help me live today with the hope of eternity in my chest. In Jesus' name, Amen.
